surfaces.atomicity: Autocommit. One row and its indexes persist in one store batch. Multi-row all-or-nothing requires an explicit transaction.
surfaces.isolation: Session committed snapshot plus the statement's own writes.
surfaces.durability: Acknowledged autocommit follows the data-group commit. Later row failures do not roll back earlier autocommit rows.
surfaces.data_group: single statement route; STREAM and SYSTEM stay non-transactional

surfaces.atomicity: Autocommit per statement unless the batch opens one explicit single-group transaction. An open transaction at the end of the batch is rolled back.
surfaces.isolation: Same session snapshot, with staged reads inside an open transaction.
surfaces.durability: Each autocommit statement and each explicit commit is acknowledged separately.
surfaces.data_group: one group inside an explicit transaction; cross-group writes rejected before commit
surfaces.retry: Do not blindly retry a batch that already committed an autocommit prefix.

surfaces.atomicity: Commit or rollback covers staged USER and SHARED mutations in one data group. Cross-group writes and STREAM or SYSTEM mutations are rejected before commit.
surfaces.isolation: Read-your-writes for staged mutations. No cross-group serializable order.
surfaces.durability: Success means the group accepted the commit. An unknown response is committed or not committed, never a partial commit.
surfaces.retry: Open a new transaction after checking the outcome.

surfaces.atomicity: The root routine owns one request transaction for USER and SHARED writes in one data group. Nested calls share it and roll back with it.
surfaces.isolation: Nested SQL sees the root staged writes. Invoker and definer rights stay on the routine.
surfaces.durability: Database effects commit with the root transaction. External HTTP and webhooks are post-commit and at-least-once.
surfaces.retry: Retry volatile calls only with an idempotency key.

surfaces.atomicity: Same coordinator as HTTP SQL. Explicit transactions are single-group. Autocommit follows the single-statement promise.
surfaces.isolation: One connection session and one open transaction block.
surfaces.durability: Commit acknowledgement matches explicit transactions. Disconnect rolls back an open transaction.
surfaces.data_group: exactly one for an explicit transaction
surfaces.retry: Check the transaction outcome before retrying.

surfaces.atomicity: Not a commit boundary. Events describe commits that already happened.
surfaces.isolation: Consistent change stream after the snapshot frontier for that subscription scope.
surfaces.durability: Live acknowledgement is not durability of the underlying write. Duplicates and gaps are visible.
surfaces.data_group: subscription scope, not a cross-group total order
surfaces.retry: Resume from the cursor, or take a new snapshot after a gap.

surfaces.atomicity: Same-group outbox intent commits with the table write. Delivery is outside that transaction.
surfaces.isolation: Consumers read committed outbox records only.
surfaces.data_group: same group as the originating write
surfaces.retry: Handlers are idempotent on the outbox identity.

surfaces.atomicity: Object bytes and the referencing row are not one atomic commit.
surfaces.isolation: Later reads authorize both the row and the file reference.
surfaces.durability: A crash can leave an unreferenced object until idempotent cleanup.
surfaces.data_group: row write follows its table group; object storage is outside the group
surfaces.retry: Retry the upload and the row write with the same file identity.

surfaces.atomicity: One documented frontier for the captured catalogs and data groups. Not PITR and not a cross-group snapshot.
surfaces.isolation: Restore serves the captured frontier in an empty environment.
surfaces.durability: A complete restore serves that committed prefix. A partial or corrupt backup fails closed.
surfaces.data_group: the groups included in the captured frontier
surfaces.retry: Restore again into an empty environment.
